project: Urbanex Realty Marketing Site & CRM Dashboard

heading.usage: Used for all majestic, large-scale headings (H1-H3). Capitalize or lowercase playfully, but maintain tight tracking. Reflects old-money luxury, authority, and elegance.

body.usage: Used for all paragraphs, UI text, small labels, and data tables in the CRM. Extremely clean, geometric but highly readable.

mono.usage: Used strictly in the Admin/CRM for invoice IDs, data points, or CSV export logs.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-body font-semibold text-urbanex-gold

primary.description: Deep authoritative navy blue. Use for primary text, large heading text, and footer background.

accent.description: Matte, sophisticated gold. No CSS gradients or slop. Use for primary buttons, active pipeline stages, and overlines.

marketing.bento_about: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (use col-span-8 and col-span-4 for asymmetry)

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous (p-8 to p-16) in marketing for a luxurious, unhurried feel. Dense (p-4 to p-6) in CRM for data efficiency.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis. Highly recommended to give 'weight' to the luxury feel.
motion.page_load: Fade up and gentle 10px translate-y on hero text. 0.8s duration, ease-out.
motion.hover_property: Slow scale up on the image (scale-105) over 0.6s. Image container MUST have overflow-hidden.
motion.marquee: 19-zone Burdwan locality marquee moving continuously. Use react-fast-marquee. Style: Pale background, dark earthy/navy text, font-body, wide gaps (gap-24).

hero_marketing.structure: Full viewport height. Background is a scroll-triggered high-end real estate video (fallback to image). Overlay is bg-black/40 (never darker).
hero_marketing.overlay_card: A 'Looking For Properties' glassmorphism promo banner floating at the bottom right or center.

property_card.gated_price: If not logged in, wrap the price text in a blur container `backdrop-blur-md bg-white/50`, showing a Lock icon and 'Sign in to see price'. Use absolute positioning over the price area.

construction_timeline.style: Vertical line on the left (md:center) using urbanex-gold. Dots on the line. Cards offset alternately. Clean, trustworthy steps.

video_modal.style: Fixed z-[100] inset-0 bg-urbanex-navy/95 backdrop-blur-sm. Centered iframe/video player. Large, elegant close button (X) top right.

admin_pipeline.kanban_style: For leads. Columns with background white, subtle border. Cards inside have left-border colored based on status.

founder_portraits.description: Smiling man in black suit, use for About page founder section.
Man in suit arms crossed, use for Contact side card.

properties.description: Modern luxury house, use for Property card 1 or Hero.
Stylish white house exterior, use for Property card 2.
Modern high rise, use for Property card 3.
Indian apartment complex, use for Property card 4.

construction.description: Construction crane and building frame. Use for Construction Service hero.
Modern urban construction site. Use for Construction timeline section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup required fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Outfit via Google Fonts.
Initialize Tailwind config with the custom colors: urbanex-navy (#0A1225), urbanex-gold (#C5A059), urbanex-ivory (#FDFBF7).
Build a robust layout structure managing both the public Marketing routes and the protected Admin routes.
Implement the gated property price mechanism logic using emergent Google Auth (mock auth if no real backend is present, but show the UX).
Admin CRM: Use Recharts for the reports and implement jsPDF for invoice generation.
Add 'Cre8nex' credit discreetly in the marketing footer.
Implement the 19-zone marquee using react-fast-marquee or CSS animations. Localities like: Kalibazar, Renaissance Township, Borehat, Goda, Nawabhat, etc.
Add a fixed Floating WhatsApp button in the bottom-right corner of the marketing pages.
Write tests and add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure gold text on white has sufficient contrast, if not, darken to gold_hover (#DBC084) or use navy for text and gold for accents.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all scroll animations.

universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Use glass-morphism carefully; ensure legible text overlays by adding an explicit background to the glass panel or a text-shadow.
Do not center align all text; rely on left alignment for readability unless in specific hero or call-to-action blocks.
Avoid default purple gradients. Adhere strictly to the Ivory/Navy/Gold palette.
